findings.impact: Provider/I-O findings have an empty pointer and the unavailable result constructor rejects them. Catalog failure before request parsing combines unknown operation/mode with exit 3 and also fails construction. Bootstrap error packaging repeats the freshness check that just failed and rethrows OSError. These paths return no typed DiscoveryResult; no authentication or publication bypass was demonstrated.
findings.repair: Use actionable schema-compatible failure pointers; classify unknown context consistently with the approved nullable failure contract without inventing evaluated context. Preserve original findings and observed capture/absence without re-running a failed freshness operation while serializing the failure, and do not claim fresh authority or successful effects. Preserve safe fixed errors, public signatures and strict schema checks; do not hide programming errors with a broad ValueError catch.
findings.minimum_controls: Public provider mismatch and early catalog failure, valid shared-runtime failure positive, and changed captured bootstrap input. Require typed outcomes, no authority fallback or extra write, and truthful observed input context.

findings.title: Projection and finding ordering exceed their prospective work reservation
findings.impact: With a 2,048-unit configured budget and one unit remaining, projection hashes 4,096 actual bytes at zero work remaining and returns an artifact. Ordering 96 distinct findings reserves 768 units but the coordinator collector alone performs 4,560 equality calls and returns a result. The initial 9,120 count also included constructor normalization; the isolated 4,560 count excludes that second pass.
findings.repair: Reserve actual cumulative decode/hash/projection/carrier and collector comparison/sort/text work before performing it. Account for the accepted collector's actual incremental work rather than assuming n-log-n behavior. Preserve accepted deduplication, ordering, truncation and byte semantics; no predecessor implementation review is required.
findings.minimum_controls: Counted tight-budget rejection before hashing/decoding/ordering and sufficient-capacity controls preserving exact artifacts/findings. Use deterministic operation counts, not timing.
